summary: Iter159 backend test of the new 'university' scope type for real-enforcement users, plus regression checks for department and faculty scopes and legacy users. New suite: tests/test_university_scope_real_enforce_iter159.py, 23 tests, run with -p no:xdist. 21 of the 23 pass. Everything requested works. A university-scoped TEST user doing a fresh login with no /auth/me call gets real_enforcement=true and adv_has_university_scope=true in the DB. With no params it sees all 15 teachers, 91 students, 4 departments and 34 courses, the same as admin. With department_id the teachers list is 200/12; with faculty_id it is 200/13. A university assignment without the teachers key gets 403. Department scope was not widened: layer2_test_emp gets teachers?department_id=L2 200/12, teachers with no params 400, teachers?faculty_id=A or B 403, students only from its own department, and departments=[L2 only]. Faculty scope was not widened either: a temp faculty-A user gets 400 with no params, 200 for faculty A, 403 for faculty B, and students/departments limited to faculty A. admin, Saeed and Salim are unchanged (admin 15/91/4, Saeed 4/72/1, Salim 13/19/3 for teachers/students/departments). The 2 failures are new scope leaks I found myself in edge cases; they are not regressions in the requested items.

critical.endpoint: GET /api/students (server.py) and other routes that use get_user_scope_filter
critical.issue: Scope leak across assignments (reproduced). The user has assignment 1 with department scope (L2) holding the read keys (students_ser_get_students and others), and assignment 2 with university scope holding ONE unrelated key (grades_grades_download_grades_template). GET /students with no params returns all 91 students, the whole university. Cause: sync_real_enforcement_context sets adv_has_university_scope=True if ANY active assignment is university-scoped, whatever its keys. get_user_scope_filter then returns {} for every scope_type. It contradicts the documented 'one assignment's scope never extends to another' rule in scope_allows/check_permission. GET /teachers is correctly 400 here, because real_enforce_guard checks the key per assignment.

critical.endpoint: GET /api/students (server.py get_current_user path) after an assignment ends
critical.issue: Widened access goes stale after an assignment ends (reproduced). The user has a department assignment plus a university assignment, both with read keys. Admin ends the university assignment via POST /advanced-access/assignments/{id}/end. The still-valid token keeps returning all 91 students. Cause: the cached flag adv_has_university_scope=True on the user doc is only re-synced by routes/deps.get_current_user or at login. The server.py get_current_user used by /students never re-syncs. GET /teachers correctly went back to 400, because the guard does a live check.

minor.issue: The login response user object does not include adv_has_university_scope (it is None), although the DB field is set correctly. The frontend cannot know about university scope at login time. This only matters if the UI depends on it.

action_items: Fix 1 (HIGH): in get_user_scope_filter, do not use a user-wide adv_has_university_scope boolean. Make university scope key-aware: only treat the user as unrestricted for scope_type X if a university-scoped active assignment actually grants the relevant read key (e.g. students_ser_get_students for 'students', academic_structure_ser_get_departments for 'departments', courses_ser_get_courses for 'courses'). Alternatively, call real_enforce_check(db, user, key, 'university', None) live, the way real_enforce_guard does.

Fix 2 (HIGH): stop relying on the cached flag in get_user_scope_filter. Compute university scope live from advanced_user_assignments there, or call sync_real_enforcement_context in server.py's get_current_user (or in get_user_scope_filter) for real-enforcement users, so that ending or suspending an assignment takes effect at once.
Optional: include adv_has_university_scope in the login response user payload.
critical_code_review_comments: Union-of-scopes design: department_ids and faculty_ids are also unioned across assignments in sync_real_enforcement_context. Before this change, a cross-assignment leak only widened a user to another department or faculty. A university assignment now widens it to everything, so the impact is much larger.

There are two get_current_user implementations (server.py, and routes/deps.py, which syncs). Any cached advanced-access field (department_ids, faculty_ids, adv_has_university_scope) can go stale on the server.py routes. The same staleness probably applies to department_ids/faculty_ids after assignment changes (not tested this round).

real_enforce_guard's university branch is correct: it is a live, per-assignment, key-aware check. Department- and faculty-scoped users still get 400 with no params, and calls with faculty_id still return 403 for department-scoped users.

success_rate.backend: 91% (21/23). All requested checks pass; the 2 failures are new edge-case leaks.

seed_data_creation: Temporary users (TEST_uniscope159, TEST_uninokey159, TEST_unimixed159, TEST_unistale159, TEST_unistale2_159, TEST_facnw159), their roles and their assignments were created and then deleted by id; I checked that 0 are left over. layer2 role 6ae98be3fbf74b036f42a7a7 was temporarily extended and then restored to exactly its original 3 keys (checked in the DB). Note: the DB holds 81 ENDED university-scope TEST_ assignments from earlier rounds (created_by admin 698dc4d65076e00e781884f8). They are not mine and I left them untouched. No active university assignments and no users with adv_has_university_scope=true remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest tests/test_university_scope_real_enforce_iter159.py -p no:xdist -v -s. Use no xdist: the module fixtures and the layer2 role change must run in sequence. TestUniversityEdge::test_mixed_dept_and_uni_assignments and TestStaleWithRemainingAssignment::test_end_uni_keep_dept should pass once both HIGH fixes are in. Valid UNI read keys: teachers_ser_get_teachers, students_ser_get_students, academic_structure_ser_get_departments, courses_ser_get_courses. The keys students_students_get_students and academic_structure_departments_get_departments are rejected by POST /advanced-access/roles as unknown, yet routes/students.py and routes/departments.py use them in real_enforce_guard. Those routes are shadowed by the server.py api_router routes registered first, so they are currently dead code.
rca of the issue: Leak 1: adv_has_university_scope is one boolean per user, set when any assignment is university-scoped. get_user_scope_filter returns an unrestricted query for that user no matter which permission key is involved. Repro: dept-L2 assignment with read keys + university assignment with only the grades key, then GET /students → 91 (admin count). Leak 2: the flag is cached on the user doc and only re-synced at login or by routes/deps.get_current_user. Repro: dept + university assignments, end the university one, then GET /students with the same token → still 91.
